The structure of Zn6Cr2Se8 (reduced formula Zn3CrSe4) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cr and Zn centers each coordinated by four Se neighbors, while Se centers adopt tetrahedral environments with two Cr and two Zn neighbors, with distances around 2.45–2.50 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts include corner-sharing between Se tetrahedra.
